notes: Labeled dataset for classify_chunk/classify_question evaluation. No prior labeled set exists for this component -- this ships empty on purpose (see Model Evaluation System Phase 2 plan, risk #2): fabricating true_label values here would violate the 'no fabricated ground truth' requirement. Each case must be added by a human reviewer who has manually decided the correct category/subcategory/office for that text. Schema per labeled case: {"case_id": str, "text": str, "true_label": str, "component": "classify_chunk"|"classify_question", "labeling_status": "labeled"}. An unlabeled placeholder only needs {"labeling_status": "unlabeled"} plus whatever fields are already known.
